senses.gloss:
1. श्चुत् (often in later language written श्च्युत्; cf. √ च्युत्) cl. 1. P. (Dhātup. iii, 4) श्चो॑तति (pf. चुश्चोत, Br. ; aor. अश्चोतीत् or अश्चुतत् Gr.; fut. श्चोतिता, श्चोतिष्यति, ib.),
to ooze, trickle, exude, drop, distil, RV.; Br.; BhP.; Bhaṭṭ.;
to shed, pour out, sprinkle, Kāv.; Kathās. :
Caus. श्चोतयति (aor. -अचुश्चुतत् inf. -श्चोतयितवै॑; cf. अभि- and आ-√ श्चुत्),
to cause to drop or flow, shed, ŚBr. :
Desid. चुश्चोतिषति, Pāṇ. vii, 4, 61, Sch.
2. श्चुत् (ifc.) distilling, sprinkling, shedding (ifc. See घृत-, मधु-श्चु॑त् &c.)
श्चुतित mfn. oozed, exuded, sprinkled, shed, Br.; &c.
